title: First band on banjo and guitar: Blind Freddy's band
summary: Before Buddy Petit he played banjo and guitar in Blind Freddy's band with Brown, Tick Chambers and Gabe on bass, working at an open-air theater.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
